units.locator: Article 13.11.3. Violation of requirements for placing and processing biometric personal data in the state information system Unified System for Identification and Authentication of Individuals Using Biometric Personal Data and other information systems providing authentication based on individuals' biometric personal data

Violation of the procedure for processing biometric personal data in the unified biometric system, the procedure for processing biometric personal data and unified biometric system vectors in the information systems of state bodies, the Central Bank of the Russian Federation and accredited organizations carrying out authentication based on individuals' biometric personal data, or requirements for information technologies and technical means intended for processing biometric personal data and unified biometric system vectors for identification and/or authentication —

units.locator: Article 13.11.3. Violation of requirements for placing and processing biometric personal data in the state information system Unified System for Identification and Authentication of Individuals Using Biometric Personal Data and other information systems providing authentication based on individuals' biometric personal data
units.text: 3. Failure to take organizational and technical measures to ensure the security of biometric personal data when they are processed in the unified biometric system or during its interaction with other information systems, or failure to take organizational and technical measures to ensure the security of biometric personal data when they are processed in other information systems providing authentication using individuals' biometric personal data, including information systems of accredited state bodies —
units.label: Part 3 Art. 13.11.3

units.locator: Article 13.11.3. Violation of requirements for placing and processing biometric personal data in the state information system Unified System for Identification and Authentication of Individuals Using Biometric Personal Data and other information systems providing authentication based on individuals' biometric personal data
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand rubles; and on legal entities, one million to one million five hundred thousand rubles.

units.locator: Article 13.11.3. units.text: 4. Processing biometric personal data or unified biometric system vectors for authentication of individuals in the information systems of state bodies or organizations or the information system of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation without accreditation, or where accreditation has been suspended or terminated —

units.locator: Article 13.11.3. Violation of requirements for placing and processing biometric personal data in the state information system Unified System for Identification and Authentication of Individuals Using Biometric Personal Data and other information systems providing authentication based on individuals' biometric personal data
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of five hundred thousand to one million rubles; and on legal entities, one million to two million rubles.

units.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules
units.text: 1. Violation of conditions stipulated in a licence to carry out activities in the field of information protection (except information constituting a state secret) —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 13.12

units.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to one thousand five hundred rubles; on officials, one thousand five hundred to two thousand five hundred rubles; and on legal entities, fifteen thousand to twenty thousand rubles.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 13.12 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on…”

units.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules
units.text: 2. Use of uncertified information systems, databases and data banks, or uncertified information protection tools, where they are subject to mandatory certification (except tools for protecting information constituting a state secret) —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 13.12

units.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of five thousand to ten thousand rubles with or without confiscation of the uncertified information protection tools; on officials, ten thousand to fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles with or without confiscation of the uncertified information protection tools.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 13.12 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on…”

units.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules
units.text: 3. Violation of conditions stipulated in a licence to carry out work involving the use and protection of information constituting a state secret, creation of tools intended to protect information constituting a state secret, implementation of measures and/or provision of services to protect information constituting a state secret —
units.label: Part 3 Art. 13.12

units.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of two thousand to three thousand rubles; and on legal entities, twenty thousand to twenty-five thousand rubles.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 13.12 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on…”

units.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules
units.text: 4. Use of uncertified tools intended to protect information constituting a state secret —
units.label: Part 4 Art. 13.12

units.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles with or without confiscation of the uncertified tools intended to protect information constituting a state secret.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 13.12 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on…”

units.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules
units.text: 5. Gross violation of conditions stipulated in a licence to carry out activities in the field of information protection (except information constituting a state secret) —
units.label: Part 5 Art. 13.12

units.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on persons engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity of two thousand to three thousand rubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days; on officials, two thousand to three thousand rubles; and on legal entities, twenty thousand to twenty-five thousand rubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 13.12 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on…”

units.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules
units.text: 6. Violation of requirements for protecting information (except information constituting a state secret) established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with them, except in the cases provided for in parts 1, 2 and 5 of this Article —
units.label: Part 6 Art. 13.12

units.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of five thousand to ten thousand rubles; on officials, ten thousand to fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 13.12 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on…”

units.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules
units.text: 7. Violation of requirements for protecting information constituting a state secret established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with them, except in the cases provided for in parts 3 and 4 of this Article, where such acts (omissions) do not constitute a criminal offence —
units.label: Part 7 Art. 13.12

units.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of ten thousand to twenty thousand rubles; on officials, twenty thousand to fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 13.12 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on…”

units.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules
units.text: Note. The concept of a gross violation shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation for the specific licensed type of activity.

Violation of requirements for creating security systems for significant facilities of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation and ensuring their operation, or requirements for ensuring the security of significant facilities of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with them, where such acts (omissions) do not contain elements of a criminal offence —

Violation of the procedure for reporting computer incidents, responding to them and taking measures to eliminate the consequences of computer attacks against significant facilities of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation, established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with them —

units.locator: Article 13.12.1. Violation of requirements for ensuring the security of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation

units.locator: Article 13.12.1. Violation of requirements for ensuring the security of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation
units.text: 3. units.label: Part 3 Art. 13.12.1

units.locator: Article 13.12.1. Violation of requirements for ensuring the security of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand rubles.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 13.12.1 · “shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on…”

units.text: Violation of rules for operating means of storing, processing or transmitting protected computer information contained in the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation, or information systems, information and telecommunications networks, automated control systems or telecommunications networks forming part of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation, or rules for access to that information, those information systems, information and telecommunications networks, automated control systems or telecommunications networks, except in the cases provided for in Article 13.12.1 of this Code, where such acts (omissions) do not contain elements of a criminal offence —

units.locator: Article 13.13. Unlawful activities in the field of information protection
units.text: 1. Engaging in types of activities in the field of information protection (except information constituting a state secret) without obtaining, in the prescribed manner, a special permit (licence), where such permit (licence) is mandatory under federal law, —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 13.13

units.locator: Article 13.13. Unlawful activities in the field of information protection
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of five hundred to one thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of information protection means; on officials, two thousand to three thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of information protection means; on legal entities, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of information protection means.

units.locator: Article 13.13. Unlawful activities in the field of information protection
units.text: 2. Engaging, without a licence, in types of activities associated with the use and protection of information constituting a state secret, the creation of means intended to protect information constituting a state secret, or the implementation of measures and (or) provision of services to protect information constituting a state secret —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 13.13

units.locator: Article 13.13. Unlawful activities in the field of information protection
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of four thousand to five thousand roubles; on legal entities, thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of means for protecting information constituting a state secret created without a licence.

units.text: Disclosure of information to which access is restricted by federal law (except where disclosure of such information entails criminal liability) by a person who obtained access to that information in connection with the performance of official or professional duties, except in the cases provided for in Part 1 of Article 14.33 and Article 17.13 of this Code, —

units.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information
units.text: 1. Production and (or) dissemination of television, video or cinema programmes, documentary and feature films, as well as information computer files and information-text processing programs belonging to special mass media, containing concealed inserts that affect people's subconscious and (or) adversely affect their health, —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 13.15

units.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on officials, four thousand to five thousand roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on legal entities, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 13.15 · “shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand…”

units.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information
units.text: 2. Dissemination of information about an organisation included in the published list of organisations recognised as extremist under the legislation of the Russian Federation, or about an organisation included in the published single federal list of organisations, including foreign and international organisations, recognised as terrorist under the legislation of the Russian Federation, without indicating that the organisation concerned has been liquidated or its activities prohibited, —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 13.15

units.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on officials, four thousand to five thousand roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on legal entities, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 13.15 · “shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand…”

units.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information
units.text: 2.1. Dissemination, in mass media and in mass-media messages and materials in information and telecommunications networks, of information about foreign agents (except information placed in unified state registers and state information systems provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation), or of materials produced by them, without indicating foreign-agent status —
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 13.15

units.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles, with or without confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on officials, four thousand to five thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on legal entities, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 13.15 · “shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand…”

units.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information
units.text: 3. Unlawful dissemination of information about a minor who has suffered as a result of unlawful actions (inaction), or violation of the requirements for dissemination of such information established by federal laws, where these actions (inaction) do not constitute a criminally punishable act, —
units.label: Part 3 Art. 13.15

units.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, four hundred thousand to one million roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 13.15 · “shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of three…”

units.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information
units.text: 4. Public dissemination of information expressing manifest disrespect for society about days of military glory and commemorative dates of Russia associated with the defence of the Fatherland, as well as public desecration of symbols of Russia's military glory, public insult to the memory of defenders of the Fatherland or public humiliation of the honour and dignity of a veteran of the Great Patriotic War, including where committed using mass media or information and telecommunications networks (including the Internet), —
units.label: Part 4 Art. 13.15

units.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine on legal entities of three million to five million roubles, with or without confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 13.15 · “shall entail an administrative fine on legal entities of three…”

units.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information
units.text: 4.1. Public dissemination of information denying facts established by the judgment of the International Military Tribunal for the trial and punishment of the major war criminals of the European Axis countries, or approving crimes established by that judgment, as well as public dissemination of knowingly false information about the activities of the USSR during the Second World War or about veterans of the Great Patriotic War, including where committed using mass media or information and telecommunications networks (including the Internet), —
